resources.string: Adds the bar’s surround effect. Off, the sound plays without it.
For late evenings: loud sounds are softened, so the volume can stay low.
Evens out sudden jumps in loudness, such as adverts louder than the programme.
Creates virtual speakers for a wider, more enveloping sound.
With a compatible BRAVIA TV, picks out voices so their level can be raised or lowered.
Narrows the gap between loud and quiet sounds, so quiet ones are easier to hear. Auto: only when the source asks for it. On: always. Off: never.
Tunes the sound for IMAX Enhanced content, as its makers intended. Auto leaves it to the bar.
Raises or lowers the low end.
The volume of the rear speakers, if there are any.
How much Voice Zoom 3 raises or lowers voices.
What the bar plays: the TV, the device on its HDMI input, or a phone over Spotify Connect, Bluetooth or AirPlay.
